verdict.rationale: Webhook event subscriptions are a fair question for a fraud-prevention SaaS, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for Radar events. The early fraud warning and reviews API objects (docs-8, docs-9) are API resources and do not establish webhook subscriptions, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
